_note: Citation registry for the thought-leadership board. Every claim on a slide carries a superscript that resolves to an entry here. Entries marked verified:false are NOT used in the deck.

sources.title: IFRS Foundation publishes jurisdictional profiles on ISSB Standards adoption
claims: 36 jurisdictions have adopted, are using, or are finalising steps to introduce ISSB Standards
Together representing ~60% of global GDP and ~40% of global market capitalisation
Initial set of 17 jurisdictional profiles published; 14 committing to full adoption

sources.title: Net Zero Roadmap: A Global Pathway to Keep the 1.5 °C Goal in Reach
claims: Clean-energy investment must rise to ~US$4.5 trillion per year by the early 2030s
Up from a record ~US$1.8 trillion in 2023

sources.title: TPT Disclosure Framework
claims: Final Disclosure Framework published 9 October 2023
Aligns with GFANZ transition-planning guidance and builds on ISSB standards
TPT concluded in 2024; disclosure materials transferred to the IFRS Foundation

sources.org: Network for Greening the Financial System (NGFS)
sources.title: NGFS publishes latest long-term climate macro-financial scenarios (Phase V, v5.0)
claims: Phase V climate scenarios (version 5.0) published November 2024
Scenario families: Orderly, Disorderly, Hot House World, Too Little Too Late
Phase V projects physical-risk GDP losses 2-4x higher than prior NGFS vintages
Used by central banks and supervisors for climate risk assessment and stress testing

sources.title: The economic commitment of climate change
claims: World economy already committed to a ~19% reduction in global income by 2050
Equivalent to ~US$38 trillion per year in damages by 2050 (likely range US$19-59 trillion)
Independent of near-term emissions choices

sources.title: State of the Voluntary Carbon Market 2025
claims: VCM reported transaction value US$535 million in 2024, down 29% from US$723 million in 2023
Transaction volume down 25%; average price down 5.5%
~182 million credits retired across top-10 standards in 2024

sources.title: Carbon Credits Come of Age in 2025
claims: VCM valued at ~US$1.5 billion in 2024 (whole-market basis)
305 million credits issued and 180 million retired in 2024
Projected US$7-35 billion by 2030 and US$45-250 billion by 2050

sources.title: State and Trends of Carbon Pricing 2025
claims: Global carbon-pricing revenues exceeded US$100 billion in 2024 (ETS + carbon taxes, not VCM)
Carbon-pricing instruments cover >24% of global emissions
~1 billion unretired credits from independent crediting mechanisms

sources.org: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI)
sources.title: Business Responsibility and Sustainability Reporting (BRSR) / BRSR Core
claims: BRSR mandatory for the top 1,000 listed companies by market capitalisation (from FY2022-23)
BRSR Core assurance phased by market-cap rank: top 150 FY2023-24, top 250 FY2024-25, top 500 FY2025-26, top 1,000 FY2026-27
